source_state: cloud current working tree; commit alone is not the full source. Bound source SHA256 is retained.

video_timing.method: first trace screencast frameSwapWallTime minus encoded first packet PTS

clockCalibration.note: Same-host wall-clock comparison; transport round trip bounds this one sample, not all later clock drift.

video_timing.limitation: Estimated visual alignment: 25 fps quantization (~40 ms), first traced/encoded frame correspondence and browser/host clock sampling. No sub-frame accuracy is claimed.
video_timing.sourceBasis: Playwright 1.64.1 coreBundle.js: VideoRecorder passes frameSwapWallTime; FfmpegVideoRecorder emits timestamp minus creationTimeMs and writes creation_time metadata.

synchronization_note: Estimated cross-host alignment using the shortest measured HTTP round trip and server observed_at_utc; preserve RTT and 25 fps frame quantization uncertainty.
view: Existing workbench frontend connected to this run through isolated capture adapter on loopback; not the original longrun server.
identity_projection: AICs mapped to A01-A07; provider identity, credentials, endpoints and machine paths removed. Numeric business results retained.
